'first' (often not a count; check): "Austria's allied pick, its first upstream or midstream sector on the Strategic Index after a resource-base screen, is midstream batteries, ranked 5th."

170 words: "Scores compare Austria with other economies in the same sector; they are not measures of risk or profit in absolute terms. All index values are the paper's baseline as of 12 October 2026; Strategic Insights recomputes them under other weightings. Some figures behind these scores are filled in where the source has no value: with zero where a source lists every holder, otherwise with the world average. Strategic Index scores within 0.01 of each other are almost tied: small changes in the data or the weights can swap their order. In the allied network design the European Union is one producer; Austria's shares are derived from its weight within the EU. The Climate Action Tracker rates the EU as a whole; Austria carries the EU's rating. Trade figures count trade with other EU members. Many allied picks are close calls: in the paper, 37% of them are within 0.01 of the runner-up. Austria's counts leave out the EU's own 438 International Energy Agency policy records. Country Insights shows the detail."
